name: Output
description: Post-protection output trim of the instrument

name: Length (s)
description: Event length when Sync = Seconds; event+tail capped by host tail limit (FX-00 C8)

name: Retrigger
description: A new NoteOn while an event plays

name: NoteOff
description: One-shot plays to its end; Gate releases on NoteOff

name: Key Track
description: How far the MIDI note moves pitched layers (0 = fixed)

name: Energy
description: Scales sweep depth, drive and brightness of all layers

name: Tilt
description: Spectral tilt of the layer mix

name: Width
description: Stereo width of the mix (1 = unchanged)

name: Drive
description: Mix saturation before the insert chain

name: Release
description: Release time in Gate mode and on retrigger fades

name: Pump Depth
description: Tempo-synced volume pump on the mix

name: Protection
description: DC blocker + soft clipper; off = true bypass

name: Motion
description: Master depth of all modulation routes

name: Start Position
description: Event starts at this fraction of its timeline

name: Tail
description: Insert-chain tail kept after the event ends; capped by the host tail limit

name: A Pan

name: A Pitch

name: A Cutoff
description: Layer filter cutoff (cutoff curve scales it)

name: A Sweep
description: Depth of the layer's family trajectory (rise/fall/chirp/pass-by)

name: A Offset
description: Layer start as a fraction of the event length (no pre-roll)

name: A Length
description: Layer duration as a fraction of the event length

name: A Character
description: The family's primary colour control (fixed meaning per family, listed in FX-01 docs)

name: A FX Send
description: Share of the layer routed through the insert chain (rest bypasses it)
